requirements.text: Ensure compliance with PSD2 and GDPR throughout the app modernisation process.
Implement real-time notifications for transactions and balance changes, prioritizing secure communication to protect sensitive information.
Retain and enhance existing features like secure login methods and access to account balances, focusing on compliance.
Consider biometric authentication methods, ensuring they meet regulatory standards.
Ensure new features integrate seamlessly with the legacy core banking system while being mindful of compliance risks.
